dedupe_keys.name: degradation aware second life battery building control

description: SLB-PV-MPC is the City-Syntax repository's model and reproducible workflow for operating second-life batteries in photovoltaic-equipped buildings. It combines an R–2RC equivalent-circuit model, state-of-health-dependent power limits, demand and PV forecasting, and day-ahead model-predictive control. Inputs include retired-cell parameters, building loads, weather and electricity prices; outputs are hourly battery-operation logs, degradation measures and lifecycle cost comparisons. The documented application uses five years from a German industrial facility, while time steps and settings can be adapted. Source is free under MIT. A limitation is that the economic results depend on cell condition, forecasts, price spreads and market assumptions; the reported savings are case results, not guaranteed performance. The workflow can support storage sizing and control studies. PyBaMM (platform-pybamm) offers related battery modelling. Notebook execution order and intermediate products are documented. No building measurements, battery tables or model weights were downloaded.
inputs: Battery cell parameters, building load and weather
name: Degradation-aware second-life battery building control
